rules.name: core-by-package-name
rules.comment: Apps reach a shared package through its name, such as @zenbu/dictionary-core or @zenbu/node-service, never a relative path into packages/ (ARCHITECTURE.md, Layers).

rules.name: web-never-imports-the-service
rules.comment: The website reaches the dictionary service only over HTTP, through src/lib/dictionary/api.ts, and shares row shapes through the core (ARCHITECTURE.md, Layers).

rules.name: web-never-imports-the-account-service
rules.comment: The website reaches the account service only over HTTP, through its /v1 API (ARCHITECTURE.md, Layers).

rules.name: worker-runs-before-nextjs
rules.comment: worker.ts runs before Next.js on every request, so nothing it imports, however indirectly, may load Next.js or React (docs/agents/web.md, Code layout). Keep what it needs in src/lib, free of both.

rules.name: only-data-reads-the-service
rules.comment: Pages read the dictionary service only through src/lib/dictionary/data.ts; only src/lib/dictionary/retired.ts, which worker.ts runs before Next.js, and scripts/write-sitemaps.ts, which writes the sitemaps at deploy, call the client too (docs/agents/web.md, Code layout). Add a function to data.ts instead.

rules.name: lib-builds-on-nothing-above-it
rules.comment: src/lib holds the data and logic that components, hooks, and routes build on, so it never imports them (docs/agents/web.md, Code layout). Move what both sides need into src/lib.

rules.name: components-never-import-routes
rules.comment: Routes (src/app) import components and hooks, never the reverse (docs/agents/web.md, Code layout). Pass what a component needs from its route as a prop, or move shared code into src/lib.

rules.name: core-by-package-name
rules.comment: Apps reach a shared package through its name, such as @zenbu/dictionary-core or @zenbu/node-service, never a relative path into packages/ (ARCHITECTURE.md, Layers).

rules.name: service-never-imports-the-website
rules.comment: The dictionary service knows nothing of the website: they share row shapes through the core, and the website calls the service over HTTP (ARCHITECTURE.md, Layers).

rules.name: service-never-imports-the-account-service
rules.comment: The dictionary service checks an account only through the account service, over HTTP and its JWKS (ADR 0014), never by importing it (ARCHITECTURE.md, Layers).

rules.name: core-by-package-name
rules.comment: Apps reach a shared package through its name, such as @zenbu/dictionary-core or @zenbu/node-service, never a relative path into packages/ (ARCHITECTURE.md, Layers).

rules.name: account-service-never-imports-another-app
rules.comment: The account service knows nothing of the website or the dictionary service: they call it over HTTP (ARCHITECTURE.md, Layers).

rules.name: account-http-never-reaches-the-database
rules.comment: src/http is the HTTP layer: it answers from what src/server.ts and src/wiring.ts hand it, through the domain, and never touches the database, photo storage, or a payment provider (docs/agents/account-api.md, Code layout). Put database code in src/db, storage code in src/storage, and a provider's in src/billing.

rules.name: account-domain-builds-on-no-layer
rules.comment: src/domain holds the account, sync, and billing rules, which the HTTP layer, the database layer, the payment providers' adapters, and photo storage build on, so it imports none of them, nor Hono, nor a database driver, nor a provider's SDK (docs/agents/account-api.md, Code layout). Take what a rule needs as a parameter.

rules.name: account-storage-keeps-files-and-nothing-more
rules.comment: src/storage keeps photo files in R2 behind the domain's PhotoStorage, and nothing more: src/server.ts and src/wiring.ts hand it to the domain, so it imports neither HTTP, the database, sign-in, email, nor the payment providers (docs/agents/account-api.md, Code layout).

rules.name: account-email-sends-and-nothing-more
rules.comment: src/email sends a message and nothing more: sign-in uses it, so it imports neither sign-in, the database, nor HTTP (docs/agents/account-api.md, Code layout).

rules.name: account-sign-in-knows-no-http
rules.comment: src/auth sets up sign-in on the database and the mailer; src/server.ts and src/wiring.ts hand its handler to the HTTP layer, so it knows nothing of HTTP (docs/agents/account-api.md, Code layout).

rules.name: account-database-knows-no-http
rules.comment: src/db is the database layer: the HTTP layer builds on it through src/server.ts and src/wiring.ts, so it knows nothing of HTTP, photo storage, or a payment provider (docs/agents/account-api.md, Code layout).

rules.name: account-billing-adapts-providers-and-nothing-more
rules.comment: src/billing holds the payment providers' adapters, Stripe's and the App Store's, behind the domain's billing interfaces; src/server.ts and src/wiring.ts hand them to the domain, so they know nothing of HTTP, the database, sign-in, email, or photo storage (docs/agents/account-billing.md, Code layout).

rules.name: core-needs-no-runtime
rules.comment: The core imports no runtime, framework, or package: a client passes in its database, files, and capabilities (ARCHITECTURE.md, Layers). Take what this needs as a parameter, or import only types.

rules.name: core-imports-no-client
rules.comment: The core is shared by every client, so it imports none of them and no repository tool (ARCHITECTURE.md, Layers). Move what it needs into the core, or pass it in.

rules.name: node-service-imports-no-app
rules.comment: What the Node services share imports none of them and no repository tool (ARCHITECTURE.md, Layers). Pass what it needs in as a parameter.
